_comment: Row 786 single-use browser grant battery. Re-run from a detached scratch copy: ./venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row786_single_use_url_fallback.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH --timeout 240. What it proves: when a download grant came only from a browser click (no static href), an HTTP failure must NOT re-click for a second download event, because the grant is single-use and the second click is spent for nothing. The mutant disables the guard (if click_only_grant: -> if False:), restoring the unconditional Playwright fallback, and the named catcher must go red. The band is the whole test file so the baseline also holds the static-href negative control green: a mutant that reddened everything would not be evidence for this guard.
subject: row 786 click-only browser grants are never re-issued after HTTP failure

mutants.label: fallback re-clicks a single-use browser grant
